manifest_permissions_required_v0.purpose: typed bridge communication with exact native helper
manifest_permissions_required_v0.constraint: host allowed_extensions contains only packaged extension ID

manifest_permissions_required_v0.purpose: managed-tab inventory/lifecycle plus URL metadata for origin-only auth/navigation risk classification
manifest_permissions_required_v0.constraint: do not read/persist title or favicon; raw URL reduced immediately to enum for managed tabs only

manifest_permissions_required_v0.purpose: non-authoritative slot/generation metadata across tab restore/restart
manifest_permissions_required_v0.constraint: no packet body, content, credential, token, or durable authority

firefox_webextension.note: webNavigation is unnecessary in v0 because tabs.onUpdated plus the already-required tabs permission can observe managed-tab URL changes.

native_helper.privilege_level: standard interactive user; no administrator/root requirement
allowed_capabilities: configured OperatorBridge connection if UX-12 selects network transport

native_messaging_host_manifest.name: com.workspacecontrol.operator_bridge
native_messaging_host_manifest.helper_message_policy: extension may report browser results/events tied to outstanding request IDs; it may not originate authority-affecting commands

constraints: profile name/path from reviewed local config, never packet
bridge does not parse profile databases
arbitrary non-managed ChatGPT tabs are not adopted
dedicated_profile.exact_launch_flags_validation_owner: UX-12 implementation smoke test; named-profile and explicit-profile-path forms must be tested on target Windows host before release

permission_change_gate.rule: Any new WebExtension/host permission, content script, helper OS privilege, page-content access, network listener, or synthetic-input capability requires new security review and ADR.

ux12_validation_required: IMPLEMENTATION SMOKE: target Firefox loads signed MV3 extension and event-page background
IMPLEMENTATION SMOKE: tabs.onUpdated managed-origin reduction emits no raw URL
IMPLEMENTATION SMOKE: sessions tab-value recovery across expected restart/restore
IMPLEMENTATION SMOKE: Native Messaging host install/allowlist/protocol handshake
IMPLEMENTATION SMOKE: dedicated-profile launch/coexistence behavior on target host
PRE-CUSTOM-SHELL-PROMOTION: normal manual ChatGPT authentication without workaround

ux12_validation.background_model: background.scripts event page; Firefox extension service_worker not used
ux12_validation.native_host_install: per-user HKCU Mozilla NativeMessagingHosts registration with absolute installed helper path
ux12_validation.local_ipc: CurrentUserOnly asynchronous named pipe; same user and elevation level required
ux12_validation.signed_distribution: AMO-signed unlisted/self-distributed XPI; no unsigned production bypass
ux12_validation.custom_shell: WebView2 spike only; normal authentication + security/performance/usability gates required before promotion
ux12_validation.openai_boundary: rechecked; automatic/programmatic Output extraction and safeguard/restriction circumvention remain prohibited
